overview.description: Brakes India Private Limited is India's largest brake system supplier and a global ferrous castings manufacturer, part of the TVS Group (TSF Group). Founded in 1962 and headquartered in Chennai, it serves automotive OEMs across India and exports castings globally.

bullets.text: Established in 1962; promoted by the TSF Group (TVS–Santhanam family), whose heritage dates to 1936. Largest brake system supplier in India.
Operates three divisions: Brake Division (braking systems for passenger cars, CVs, tractors), Foundry Division (ferrous castings for global OEMs), and Polymer Division.

Foundry Division at Sholinghur (120km from Chennai) produces over 200,000 MT/year of safety-critical ferrous castings; also operates a foundry in Oman. Won the prestigious Deming Application Prize for TQM.
Revenues exceed INR 6,500 crore per company's own LinkedIn disclosure; target of INR 10,000 crore turnover cited in press reports.
Exports account for approximately 23% of total revenues across brake and foundry divisions, per CRISIL.
Sells automotive spare parts under the TVS-Girling, TVS-Apache, and TVS-Sprinter brands in the Indian aftermarket.
Employs approximately 9,588 people; CIN U35999TN1962PTC004928; balance sheet last publicly filed with ROC Chennai for FY2023 (most recent available).

financials.note: Brakes India is unlisted with no investor relations site. MCA filings are paywalled. The only available figures come from company's own LinkedIn (revenue >₹6,500 cr, unaudited/undated) and third-party aggregators of uncertain methodology. No audited annual figures are publicly accessible. The table below reflects what could be verified — year-by-year breakdowns could NOT be confirmed and are not shown.

products.name: Disc & Drum Brake Systems (Passenger Vehicles)
products.description: Calipers, actuation systems, drum brakes, ABS, brake valves, hose, and brake fluid for passenger cars. Supplied to Indian automotive OEMs.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle Brakes (S-Cam, Hydraulic, Disc, EMR)
products.description: S-cam brakes, hydraulic drum brakes, disc brakes, and Electro Magnetic Retarders for trucks, buses, and CVs.

products.name: Ferrous Castings (Grey Iron & SG Iron)
products.description: Permanent mould grey iron and SG iron castings manufactured via Disamatic high-pressure moulding process at Sholinghur and Oman facilities. Over 200,000 MT annual capacity.

products.name: Aftermarket Spare Parts (TVS-Girling / TVS-Apache / TVS-Sprinter)
products.description: Branded brake components sold through the Indian automotive aftermarket under three TVS sub-brands.

clients.name: Global automotive OEMs (foundry exports — specific names not publicly disclosed)
